newsitem.title: GERMANY: BOXING-MICHALCZEWSKI BEATS HILL TO TAKE WBA TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-MICHALCZEWSKI BEATS HILL TO TAKE WBA TITLE.

text.p: Germany's Dariusz Michalczewski beat U.S. holder Virgil Hill on a unanimous points decision on Friday to take the WBA light-heavyweight title.
The 29-year-old from Hamburg also holds the IBF and WBO titles in the category.
"I am now ready for any fighter in the world," Michalczewski said.
"Whether I have zero or four belts I will always be your tiger," he told the 10,000-strong crowd after the win, which brings his career earnings to 2.5 million marks ($1.4 million).

The 33-year-old Hill, coming to terms with his first defeat in six years and only the second of his professional career, said: "That was a difficult and unexpected defeat for me... Dariusz fought fantastically. It was a great fight. It was really hard."
